# Support SentinAI

SentinAI is an open-source self-healing DevOps agent — built to detect production failures, call an LLM, and propose a code patch before your on-call engineer opens their laptop.

This project is independently developed and maintained by a first-year ICT student at Mbeya University of Science and Technology (MUST), Tanzania, built to Silicon Valley quality standards.

---

## Why Sponsorship Matters

Running a production-grade AI tool has real infrastructure costs:

| Service | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Render (API Hosting) | Keeps the SentinAI backend live at sentinai.onrender.com |
| Anthropic Claude API | LLM-powered incident analysis and patch generation |
| OpenAI API | Alternative LLM provider support |
| Docker Hub | Public container registry (`ebencodex/sentinai:latest`) |
| GitHub Actions | CI/CD pipeline — 686 tests on every push |
| AWS (roadmap) | Production-grade cloud deployment |

Every contribution directly funds the infrastructure and API costs that keep this project alive and free for the community.

---

## What Your Support Enables

- Keeping the live demo free and accessible
- Covering LLM API costs as usage grows
- AWS deployment for production-grade reliability
- Multi-tenant SaaS features for teams
- macOS and Linux desktop builds
- Continued open-source development
